name: Engineering Metrology, Offline Security & Licensing Hardening
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.2.6 strengthens mirrored-part CNC and printability geometry transforms, active-unit report and CSV exports, STEP AP242 and DXF parser resilience, strict clinical no-cache and air-gapped enterprise policy isolation, command-palette accuracy, and online/Stripe license revocation and seat reliability.

highlights.title: Mirrored CAD Transforms, Mass Inertia & Reports
highlights.text: Preserves exact handedness and winding orientation across mirrored assembly parts during 3-axis CNC machining readiness and 3D printability checks, refines Cartesian inertia and center-of-mass validation, and ensures clean customer-facing formatting in exported RFQ and design review HTML reports.

highlights.title: Active-Unit Exports & STEP/DXF Parsing
highlights.text: Aligns CSV, BOM, tolerance, and metrology report exports to the active workspace unit system, hardens STEP AP242 semantic and graphical PMI extraction against malformed entities, and improves Direct DXF Preflight resilience on non-standard header and layer definitions.

highlights.title: Clinical No-Cache & Enterprise Offline Security
highlights.text: Enforces strict no-cache isolation for clinical sessions without retaining recent models or thumbnails on disk, strengthens fail-closed enterprise offline policy enforcement for air-gapped deployments, and isolates diagnostic logs from sensitive part metadata.

highlights.title: Command Palette & Session Lifecycle Consistency
highlights.text: Aligns command-palette actions and keyboard shortcuts with active workspace permissions and view modes, and cleans up section planes, issue overlays, and temporary session state reliably when switching or closing models.

highlights.title: Licensing Revocation, Concurrency & Web Portal
highlights.text: Hardens online license refresh, deactivation, and Stripe webhook handling so revoked or refunded keys stay blocked, protects multi-seat activations with database concurrency guards, and improves checkout verification polling and billing portal feedback on the web portal.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake, CNC DFM, DXF preflight, Release Review reconciliation, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
Managed offline mode ('no_external_network') provides technical egress controls and is not a claim of organizational ISO/IEC 27001 certification or TISAX assessment.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md; see docs/SBOM.cdx.json.
